basis: Thirty actual 125-marker ASTRAL-III 5.7.8 inferences: two alignments x five full/closed taxon cohorts x three explicit support-contraction settings, all full data without a biological pilot. Local jar and all three dependencies exactly match official archive; native six-taxon resolved/missing/polytomous contracts passed. Java21 -Xmx28G with two available processors, service2CPU32GiB/noSwap/1BLAS. ASTRAL algorithm is mostly single threaded; adding arbitrary worker threads is not meaningful. TwoGiB output allowance and100GiB disk reserve. Native runtime on 500 taxa/high discordance is uncalibrated; full independent scoring/comparison/journal closure remains required. No GPU, paid resources or restart/mutation of existing analyses.
